title: After the Sunset
description: An FBI agent (Woody Harrelson) thinks a master thief (Pierce Brosnan) and his girlfriend (Salma Hayek) will try to steal a valuable diamond from a cruise ship.

title: Monkey Trouble
description: A 9-year-old (Thora Birch) learns her new pet monkey worked as a pickpocket for a Gypsy hustler (Harvey Keitel).

title: New York Minute
description: An uptight teenager (Ashley Olsen) and her laid-back twin (Mary-Kate Olsen) spend a wild day on the streets of Manhattan.

title: The Killing Fields
description: Newsman Sydney Schanberg loses his friend Dith Pran in the 1975 fall of Phnom Penh.

title: The Corruptor
description: An NYPD recruit (Mark Wahlberg) and his superior (Chow Yun-Fat) work to dampen the war between Triads and Dragons in Chinatown.

title: Beyond the Poseidon Adventure
description: Salvagers (Michael Caine, Sally Field) seeking cash and a madman (Telly Savalas) seeking plutonium are trapped with survivors in an upside-down ocean liner.

title: My Giant
description: A sleazy showbiz agent (Billy Crystal) tries to exploit a very large, gentle man (Gheorghe Muresan) he discovered in a Romanian monastery.

title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
description: A Belgian captain brings the ape-raised son (Christopher Lambert) of shipwrecked aristocrats home to his estate, his grandfather (Ralph Richardson) and Jane (Andie MacDowell) in Edwardian England.

title: Who's That Girl?
description: A hapless New Yorker's (Griffin Dunne) rich future father-in-law orders him to escort a bleached blonde (Madonna) out of town.

title: Arthur
description: A dry British butler (John Gielgud) helps his tippling master (Dudley Moore) choose love with a waitress (Liza Minnelli) or marriage for money.

title: Pleasantville
description: A shy suburban teen and his sister are transported into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom.

title: A Prairie Home Companion
description: The creator (Garrison Keillor) of a long-running radio show conducts business as usual while his guests, cast and crew (Meryl Streep, Lindsay Lohan, Kevin Kline) prepare for the final broadcast.

title: Transcendence
description: A scientific genius's (Johnny Depp) controversial attempts to create a sentient machine take an unforeseen turn after he is mortally wounded during an attack by anti-technology radicals.

title: Frequency
description: Thirty years after the death of his father, a police officer is stunned to find himself communicating with him thanks to an old ham radio.

title: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Evil Mage Profion (Jeremy Irons) seeks Empress Savina's (Thora Birch) magic scepter in his quest to overtake the kingdom of Izmer for his group of magic users.

title: Rumble in the Bronx
description: A Hong Kong policeman (Jackie Chan) in New York defends a woman shopkeeper (Anita Mui) against bikers who want protection money.

title: Deep Cover
description: An undercover officer (Larry Fishburne) hooks up with a lawyer (Jeff Goldblum) who deals drugs for a West Coast cartel run by a foreign diplomat.

title: Sweet November
description: A workaholic executive (Keanu Reeves) and an unconventional woman (Charlize Theron) agree to a personal relationship for a trial period of one month.

title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
description: Two overbearing mothers try to help their daughters win a beauty contest for the title of Dairy Queen.

title: No Reservations
description: A career-centered chef (Catherine Zeta-Jones) faces important changes in her life when she becomes her young niece's guardian and crosses forks with a brash employee in her kitchen.

title: Ghosts of Mississippi
description: A Mississippi prosecutor (Alec Baldwin) and the widow (Whoopi Goldberg) of Medgar Evers crusade to retry a white racist (James Woods) for the 1963 murder of the NAACP leader.

title: Chaos Theory
description: After his wife (Emily Mortimer) plays a prank on him, an efficiency expert (Ryan Reynolds) finds himself subject to the random nature of life.

title: Guilty by Suspicion
description: During the 1950s anti-Communist witch-hunts, a film director's career and personal life begin crumbling after he is accused of communist ties and blacklisted.

title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
description: A CIA operative goes undercover to find a former agent selling nuclear secrets to the Russians.

title: Ready to Rumble
description: Two die-hard fans vow to help wrestler Jimmy the King make a comeback after a loss destroys what was left of his career.

title: The Ant Bully
description: Tired of weathering constant attacks on their colony, ants shrink a destructive boy (Zach Tyler Eisen) to their size and sentence him to live among them until he learns the errors of his ways.

title: Caddyshack II
description: The snobby president (Robert Stack) of a country club tees off with a self-made man (Jackie Mason) whose daughter wants to join.

title: Beautiful Creatures
description: Teens (Alden Ehrenreich, Alice Englert) in a backwater Southern town encounter a history of family secrets and a curse that looms for one as she approaches her 16th birthday.

title: Private Benjamin
description: A pampered Jewish widow (Goldie Hawn) is tricked into joining the Army and unexpectedly finds a new sense of purpose and self-worth.

title: Message in a Bottle
description: A woman (Robin Wright Penn) learns that the author of a romantic note that washed ashore is a shipbuilder (Kevin Costner) whose wife died young and tragically.

title: Disorderlies
description: A greedy heir (Anthony Geary) hires three inept, rap-singing orderlies (The Fat Boys) to care for his rich uncle (Ralph Bellamy).

title: Driving Miss Daisy
description: An Atlanta widow (Jessica Tandy) and her chauffeur (Morgan Freeman) reflect the changing times, from 1948 to 1973.

title: Stroker Ace
description: NASCAR driver Stroker Ace runs into problems when a confrontation with his commercial sponsor causes him to lose his contract. Clyde Torkle, the owner of a fried-chicken chain, immediately asks Stroker to be the face of his company.

title: Arthur
description: An irresponsible playboy (Russell Brand) must choose between an arranged marriage that will ensure his future wealth or following his heart with a woman (Greta Gerwig) he truly loves.

title: The Adventures of Pluto Nash
description: A nightclub owner finds himself in hot water when he refuses to sell his club to the local mob; the lunar gangsters are helping the mysterious Rex Crater mastermind a plan to take over the moon.

title: Osmosis Jones
description: One white blood cell's race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus.

title: Graffiti Bridge
description: The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain."

title: Suburban Commando
description: A warrior (Hulk Hogan) from another galaxy escapes to Earth and moves in with an architect (Christopher Lloyd) and his wife (Shelley Duvall).

title: Clara's Heart
description: A housekeeper (Whoopi Goldberg) befriends the teenage son of the bickering Baltimore couple (Michael Ontkean, Kathleen Quinlan) who brought her from Jamaica.

title: Conspiracy Theory
description: An obsessive New York cabby (Mel Gibson), in love with a government worker (Julia Roberts), learns that one of his suspicions is justified.

title: Tenacious D in: The Pick of Destiny
description: Musicians JB (Jack Black) and KG (Kyle Gass) form rock group Tenacious D and set out on a quest for a legendary guitar pick that will make them the greatest band in the world.

title: Barcelona
description: Women and Cold War politics surround a U.S. sales rep (Taylor Nichols) and his Navy-officer cousin (Chris Eigeman) in Spain.

title: Hearts in Atlantis
description: A mysterious man (Anthony Hopkins) with a very rare ability enters the lives of a widow (Hope Davis) and her son (Anton Yelchin) in Connecticut.

title: Big Girls Don't Cry... They Get Even
description: Their mixed-up family follows when an unhappy teen (Hillary Wolf) and her stepbrother flee into the woods.
